ordersText.title: A SINGLE THRUST
ordersText.general: If this advance order results in a combat, you may play an additional combat card during the first round. *newline* However, after each round of combat your combat cards are discarded and do not carry over to future rounds. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: PURE GENESEED
ordersText.general: While resolving this order you may spend forge tokens as if they were cache tokens. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: SHEER PERFECTION
ordersText.general: Your combat deck may consist of 8 cards. If there are 10 cards in your combat deck when you purchase combat upgrades, you may discard an additional pair of combat cards from your deck. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: SONIC AMPLIFIERS
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. *newline*  During this orbital strike you may spend 2 [B] to destroy a structure on the targeted world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: UNBRIDLED HEDONISM
ordersText.general: While resolving this order there is no limit on the number of upgrades you may purchase of each type. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: UNEXPECTED TRICK
eventsText.general: Resolve an advance order in any system. You cannot move ground units or initiate combat during this advance, but you can initiate an orbital strike. If you do, gain 1 [D] during this orbital strike.

eventsText.title: PROSPERO, FOREVER
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* While resolving an order you may discard this card to increase your command level by 1 and gain 2 materiel.

eventsText.title: WARP REALITY
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this scheme any time your opponent plays a combat card during a combat. He cannot resolve any of the card's abilities.

eventsText.title: THE GREAT PLAN
eventsText.general: Remove 1 of your order tokens from the game. If you do, all other players must place a matching token on top of their event decks after the end of the current Even phase. They will place 1 fewer order token during the next Planning phase.

eventsText.title: PRODIGAL SONS
eventsText.general: Choose a neutral void in a system containing no friendly areas. Either place up to 2 free Hellfire Cruisers in that void or spend 1 forge token to place 1 free Relic Battlebarge in that void.

eventsText.title: KNWOLEDGE IS THE GREATEST TREASURE
eventsText.general: Gain 1 materiel for every friendly void. If you gained 2 or less materiel, draw and resolve an additional event card (but do not move warp storms again).

eventsText.title: UNWIND TIME
eventsText.general: After all warp storms have been moved, players must immediately move warp storms again using the same movement they used previously, starting with you and going in a clockwise order.

eventsText.title: MASTERY OF THE WARP
eventsText.general: Rotate 2 system tiles around a shared warp storm boundary. *newline* Maintain all units, structures, tokens, and any other assets as well as the orientation of those tiles relative to each other.

combatText.title: ELDRICH SMITE
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. You may spend it to force your opponent to lose a matching [D].
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose a matching [D].

combatText.title: PROTECTION OF THE WARP
combatText.general: If you have more [M] than your opponent, gain 1 [S] and 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Either rally 1 unit or gain 1 [M].

combatText.title: EMBRACE MADNESS
combatText.general: Convert up to 3 of your opponent's [D] to [B], [S] or [M] in any combination.
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Gain 1 (S) for each of your opponent's [M].

combatText.title: WARD OF CHANGE
combatText.general: You must simultaneously convert all of your [B] to [S], all of your [S] to [M] and all of your [M] to [B].

combatText.title: FICKLE SORCERY
combatText.unit: Acolyte: You must reroll all your [M]. For each new [M] rolled, gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: INFERNAL FLAMES
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Heldrake/Lord of Change: Destroy an enemy CL0 unit for each [M] you have. Gain 1 (B) for every unit destroyed.

combatText.title: PINK HORRORS
combatText.general: Your opponent gains 1 [B] and you gain 2 [B].
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Gain 1 (B) for each [S] rolled while resolving the general ability of this card.

combatText.title: BLUE HORRORS
combatText.general: Resolve the general ability of a Combat card you have removed from your deck.
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose 1 [M]. If he did, gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: MEDDLING OF TZEENTCH
combatText.general: During this combat, the last card played by your opponent (at any particular moment) provides no combat icons.
combatText.unit: Acolyte: Discard one of your opponent's combat cards in play.

combatText.title: TERROR FROM ABOVE
combatText.unit: Heldrake/Cruiser/Relic Battlebarge: Your opponent must reroll a number of [D] (of your choice) equal to the current combat round.

combatText.title: EMBRACE OF THE WARP
combatText.general: Your opponent must choose and discard 1 [D]. *newline* Gain 1 [D].
combatText.unit: Heldrake/Cruiser/Relic Battlebarge: If [M] was discarded or gained while resolving the general ability of this card, gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: ALTER THE PAST
combatText.general: Play a combat card you have removed from your deck. Do not resolve its abilities but gain its icons during this combat.
combatText.unit: Acolyte: Resolve the general ability of the played card.

combatText.title: THE GREAT PLAN
combatText.unit: Lord of Change/Relic Battlebarge: Replace any of your cards in play with cards from your hand. Do not resolve the abilities of the newly played cards.

combatText.title: MAGNUS'S PENANCE
combatText.general: Resolve the abilities of all your combat cards in play, starting from the earliest one. Then discard this card and play the top card from your deck. Do not resolve its abilities but gain its icons during this combat.
